For an 8 x 8 image turned by 30 degrees with the size kept, output pixel (5, 2) has its center at (5.5, 2.5). Relative to the image center (4, 4) that is (1.5, -1.5). Turned back by 30 degrees and moved to pixel-center units, it lands at u = 5.549, v = 2.951 in the source. Bilinear interpolation then mixes source pixels (5, 2) to (6, 3) with weights from the fractions 0.549 and 0.951.
